name: Katikies Kirini Santorini
insider_take: Perched on Santorini's dramatic caldera cliffs, this boutique sanctuary offers front-row seats to the world's most legendary sunsets in complete luxury.
whats_special: Katikies Kirini features authentic Cycladic cave suites carved directly into the volcanic cliffs, each with private terraces overlooking the Aegean Sea. The hotel's infinity pools seem to merge seamlessly with the horizon, while the property's location in Oia places you in the heart of Santorini's most photographed village with its iconic blue-domed churches and windmills.
pro_tip: Book a caldera-facing suite on the hotel's western edge for unobstructed sunset views, and arrive at your terrace 30 minutes early with champagne – the famous Santorini sunset happens quickly and draws crowds to the village below.
dont_miss: The hotel's signature dining experience on your private terrace during sunset, exploring the nearby Maritime Museum housed in a 19th-century mansion, and taking the scenic footpath to Fira (about 6 miles) that winds along the caldera edge past traditional cave houses and ancient ruins.
pros: Stunning clifftop location with panoramic Aegean Sea views
Sophisticated Cycladic architecture with luxury cave-style suites
World-class infinity pools overlooking the caldera
Exceptional fine dining with Mediterranean cuisine and sunset views
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects exclusive positioning
Remote clifftop location requires transportation to main town areas
